grants.title: Tilskudd til friluftslivsaktivitet
grants.amount_note: The grant page gives no maximum amount. You plan to request 60000 NOK, so ask the grant provider what the limit is.
grants.why_qualifies: The grant supports organised outdoor activities that get more people into friluftsliv. Your free hiking, campfire and canoe days for children aged 6-12 in Stange are organised outdoor activities, and your club is a registered voluntary organisation.
attachments: The grant page lists no required attachments. Check the application form to see what you need to upload.
steps: Open the application portal of Miljødirektoratet, linked from the grant page.
Describe your outdoor activity days for children aged 6-12 in Stange.
Fill in the electronic form and state the amount you request.
Send only one application, even if you have several activities.
Confirm the deadline on the grant page before applying.
